_doc: Shared test-vectors for the llm-host multi-host knob-precedence contract (design_leira_multihost_full §Knob-precedence). CONSUMED BY BOTH TWINS: tests/test_leira_multihost_symmetry.py (Python) + tests/leira_multihost_symmetry.Tests.ps1 (PowerShell). Prime Directive #1 (project_style_guide) — every SSOT ships a count-agnostic structural pin in the same change; this JSON is that SSOT. Adding a new vector here MUST make both twins add a new test case; if either twin skips a vector the symmetry harness fails. Vector IDs are stable + sortable so cross-twin failure output aligns line-by-line. Landed 2026-07-17 in Drive-A of the llm-host multi-host completion arc, closing the DA follow-on NTH from Drive-16 (state_2026-07-17_0900_edt).

_schema.id: sortable string (V01-, V02-, ...) — used in test IDs; sortable so parametrized output aligns cross-twin
_schema.name: human label — echoed into failure output
_schema.env: map of env-var -> value; missing keys unset. Empty object == no env set. Only OLLAMA_HOST/LEIRA_URL/OLLAMA_URL supported today (the multi-host knobs).
_schema.expect_active_host_name: string; the value active_host_name() / (Get-LeiraActiveHost) MUST return. Absent when expect_raises is set.
_schema.expect_active_host_url: OPTIONAL string; when set, both twins assert the resolved URL matches (Python: mod.LEIRA_URL; PS: (_ResolveActiveHost).Url). Skip when the vector is a name-only test.
_schema.expect_raises: OPTIONAL string; the class-name a twin MUST raise. Only 'LeiraConfigError' supported today.
_schema.expect_message_contains: OPTIONAL list of substrings; every element must be a substring of the raised exception message (case-sensitive).

vectors.name: no env set -> resolves to config default_host ('llm-host')
LEIRA_URL env -> raw URL bypasses hosts map (drawer rule 1)
OLLAMA_URL env -> raw URL bypasses hosts map (drawer rule 2, LEIRA_URL alias)
OLLAMA_HOST=<unknown> + LEIRA_URL=<url> -> raw URL wins (rule 1 > rule 3, DA drive MF)
